analysis.title: TFT meta lineups
analysis.description: Lineup strength, popularity, and contest rate calculated from collected high-tier matches. An explicitly scoped observed preview is shown until patch publications are ready.

preview.pageDescription: Final boards from complete lobbies discovered by one finished ranked crawl; no tier claim is made for each participant in those lobbies.
preview.title: The first real final boards are ready to explore
preview.description: These are exact final-board aggregates from one completed crawl run, filtered through a separate static catalog to remove summoned units and ordered by average placement. They are useful for an early look, but they are not yet a patch-specific meta publication.
preview.provenance: Raw Riot version: {{version}}. Purchasable units use {{catalogSource}} {{catalogPatch}} ({{catalogRevision}}), while names and images reference {{assetSource}} {{assetPatch}} ({{assetRevision}}); neither static version is presented as the match patch.

preview.noLineupsDescription: The current threshold is {{minSamples}}. This preview cannot go below 20 samples because very small groups would be misleading.
preview.error: Could not load the observed lineup preview
preview.errorDescription: Real match data exists, but the preview aggregation failed. Please retry.

lineup.unitStarCoverage: {{known}} recorded, {{unknown}} missing, {{coverage}} coverage; shares use all lineup samples as the denominator
lineup.unitStarDistributionLabel: {{unit}} at {{stars}} stars: {{rate}} of lineup samples, {{samples}} samples, {{strength}}
lineup.starStrengthDescription: An “item core” has at least 60% average item-slot investment and at least 75% of the lineup maximum; ties share a rank. It does not claim carry or tank role. Each unit shows its 1–4 star distribution, while lineup performance is grouped by the complete star composition so different boards with the same total are not merged. Strength rows require at least 5 samples and show observed associations, not evidence that items or upgrades caused the result.
lineup.starCompositionCoverage: {{known}} complete records, {{unknown}} incomplete, {{coverage}} coverage. Strength is shown only for compositions with at least 5 samples.
